Cole says Kendrick’s “LIKE THAT” diss put him in a difficult position because Kendrick was already featured on the album 👀

“Fk. Damn, I got this n*a on the album. Puts me in a weird position.”

Cole says he felt pressure to “respond without responding” while trying to save face — ultimately forcing him to go back and rework an album he thought was already FINISHED.

“I’m retired, uninspired in my mind.”

Kendrick was really supposed to be on THE FALL-OFF… 😳🔥
